answer: Like light through a prism, split each new identity registration proof into three separate checks — a hardware fingerprint, a live work sample, and a peer endorsement — that must all converge on one public key, like a pearl forming only when every layer is real and a cedar growing only from a single root. A faker must forge a distinct device, a distinct body of live work, and a distinct trusted sponsor for every fake identity, tripling the cost of each Sybil.
